column1: # chain-preflight-v1: unified pre-chain preflight node table (shadow mode: emits verdict, never blocks chain start).
# Schema (4 TAB-separated columns; M3 parse2-bind and M4 template-compile / sys-six-target append rows here):
# - name:      unique node id ([a-z0-9_-]+), e.g. root-types, snap-cache-types, parse2-bind, template-compile, sys-six-target
# - patterns:  comma-separated trigger path prefixes/globs, or '*' for always-run nodes
# - cmd:       command executed from ROOT (bounded by timeout_s)
# - timeout_s: per-node hard timeout in seconds (1..55)
